newsitem.title: UK: Inmarsat launches global mobile satellite phone.
newsitem.headline: Inmarsat launches global mobile satellite phone.

text.p: Inmarsat said it had launched a new range of mobile satellite phones, which can handle voice, data and fax services from nearly everywhere in the world.
The introduction follows the successful launch of an Inmarsat telecommunications satellite early in September.
Inmarsat is a multinational co-operative based in London. The smallest phone in the new range weighs two kilogrammes, the smallest of its type in the world, Inmarsat said.
